steps.description: Incident commander simultaneously notifies Legal, IT Security, and PR within 1 hour of discovery.

evidence.quote: the incident commander must simultaneously notify Legal, IT Security, and the PR team within 1 hour of discovery

steps.description: Legal is engaged to determine whether regulatory reporting is required under GDPR (72 hours) or CCPA (45 days).

evidence.quote: Legal must determine whether regulatory reporting is required. Under GDPR, notification to the relevant data protection authority must occur within 72 hours of discovery. Under CCPA, notification to affected individuals must occur within 45 days.

steps.description: IT Security isolates all affected systems immediately upon notification.

evidence.quote: IT Security must isolate all affected systems immediately upon notification.

steps.description: PR prepares a customer-facing communication in parallel with Legal and IT Security response.
Legal reviews and approves the customer communication before it is sent to any external party.

evidence.quote: Legal must review and approve the customer communication before it is sent to any external party.

steps.description: PR sends the customer-facing communication after Legal approval.

evidence.quote: before it is sent to any external party

steps.description: If more than 500 individuals are affected, the Data Protection Authority is notified in addition to standard regulatory notifications.

evidence.quote: If more than 500 individuals are affected by the breach, the Data Protection Authority (DPA) must also be notified in addition to any standard regulatory notifications.

refusalTraps.reason: proactive proposal to draft a template — not a current procedural step

legal approval gate before PR communication send missed
